81871.subject: 📉 Crypto outflows continue as more hacks surface
81871.body:
———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $77,067 (-1.2%) | **ETH** $2,266 (-1.2%) | **SOL** $93 (-2.1%)

* Nasdaq 100 enters correction territory after [10% drop](https://x.com/Barchart/status/2117424746031628428) from peak as semiconductors extend three-day rout

* US crude falls below [$100](https://x.com/MarioNawfal/status/2117232762881032476) a barrel on hopes for a US-Iran diplomatic breakthrough

* Mercado Bitcoin suspends deposits and withdrawals after Hypernative flags [$40M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/mercado-bitcoin-suspends-withdrawals-eczq6yt) in suspicious outflows

* US spot Bitcoin ETFs post [$399M](https://cryptobriefing.com/us-bitcoin-ether-etfs-outflows-november/) in daily net outflows as Ether ETFs lose $140M

* ZachXBT raises EU entity hack estimate to [$133M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/european-entity-crypto-theft-monero-e973zm3) after tracing $27M more in CEX withdrawals

* Strategy buys 811 bitcoin for $65.5M, lifting total holdings to [849,327 BTC](https://www.chooserich.live/story/strategy-buys-bitcoin-repurchases-shares-ajqqdz5)

* Tether now owns about 150,000 Bitcoin worth over [$11.5B](https://www.chooserich.live/story/tether-bitcoin-holdings-qnbsmeg)

* Apple posts fiscal Q4 revenue of [$114.5B](https://www.chooserich.live/story/apple-earnings-ceo-john-ternus-gcc4xuk), beating estimates as tariff refunds lift results

* Binance says deposits and withdrawals are largely normal with [95%](https://x.com/CryptoSavingExp/status/2117534067772309596) of hacked assets replenished

* BitMine's holdings reach [6.06M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/bitmine-buys-ethereum-yhwygd7) ETH after adding 8,573 ETH

* SEC releases new FAQ clarifying its [taxonomy](https://www.chooserich.live/story/sec-crypto-token-taxonomy-faq-ic2amvu) for crypto tokens

* New Jersey drops its [staking lawsuit](https://www.chooserich.live/story/new-jersey-drops-coinbase-lawsuit-cm3jswg) against Coinbase, clearing the way to resume staking

* Binance publishes a [zero-knowledge reserve proof](https://unchainedcrypto.com/binance-publishes-zero-knowledge-reserve-proof-for-btc-eth-and-8-other-tokens-after-hack/) for BTC, ETH and 8 other tokens

* Morgan Stanley downgrades Coinbase to underweight, cuts price target to [$120](https://www.chooserich.live/story/morgan-stanley-downgrades-coinbase-zc73xyt)

———————————————————————————


———
